identitySignals: Name matches 'Comtel Systems Technology' (comtelsys.com), a communications and security systems integrator; Beacon Communications' page on Comtel gives its Northern California base as Sunnyvale, CA, matching the agenda location 'Sunnyvale, CA'
Company website says it serves K-12 education with intercom, bell and sound reinforcement systems, consistent with OUSD contracts for PA (public address) system replacement projects
Company's phone (408) 543-5600 is a Silicon Valley area code consistent with a Sunnyvale-based firm
research.notes: Comtel's own site lists a Pleasanton, CA headquarters address (7133 Koll Center Pkwy) while Beacon's page and older listings give 1292 Hammerwood Ave, Sunnyvale, CA 94089; address and headquarters left null because of the conflict. profile.summary: Comtel Systems Technology is a company that designs, installs and maintains communications and security systems, such as nurse call, intercom, public address, access control and structured cabling. It serves healthcare, education, government and commercial customers, mainly in Northern California. It has been owned by Beacon Communications since 2022.

review.notes: Both cited pages show Comtel Systems Technology, Inc. (Sunnyvale-area, serving K-12 with intercom/bell systems) with the stated phone, email, Northern California focus and the April 2022 Beacon Communications acquisition, matching the PA system replacement work OUSD contracts for. The summary is neutral; the only soft spot is 'public address' being inferred from intercom/bell/audio-visual wording, which is minor.
